review_candidates.description: Job Description: WATA Software is looking for Application Support Engineers (Java) to join a technical team responsible for the management, maintenance, and support of enterprise IT solutions. The role focuses on monitoring and resolving application support incidents, maintaining Java-based solutions, supporting technical deployments, and ensuring the stability and reliability of client environments. Candidates will collaborate with the Managed Services Helpdesk, technical consultants, and architecture teams to troubleshoot issues, maintain technical documentation, and support the development and improvement of IT solutions. This position requires strong English communication skills, flexibility to work in rotating shifts, and participation in a mandatory 24x7 on-call rotation to support clients and teams across the UK and Vietnam. Key Responsibilities:  Monitor, manage, investigate, and resolve application support incidents in coordination with the central Managed Services Helpdesk. Maintain and support Java-based solutions and client environments, ensuring system stability and service reliability. Perform standardized and customized technical activities related to the deployment, configuration, maintenance, and support of client environments. Conduct technical and process analysis to gather information, identify root causes, and resolve application issues. Participate in the development of new IT solutions, products, and technical tools. Collaborate with architecture teams to assess the feasibility of end-to-end client solutions and ensure alignment with the client's technical and business direction. Provide design and specification development support to technical consultants. Respond to functional and technical queries and requests for information. Create, maintain, and update client-specific technical documentation and support procedures. Follow source code management, code review, IT security, and ITIL-based service management practices. Work closely with geographically distributed teams and clients across the UK and Vietnam. Participate in a mandatory 24x7 on-call rotation and provide after-hours support when required. Work according to the assigned shift schedule, including regular night shifts. Requirement:  Strong English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with international teams and clients. Hands-on experience with Node.js or AngularJS. Experience with Java web technologies, including JSP and Servlets. Knowledge of web frameworks such as Struts or Spring. Experience with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and web services, including SOAP and REST. Good understanding of web technologies, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery. Familiarity with markup and data exchange formats, including XML and JSON. Experience with AngularJS, Webpack, HTML, and CSS3 in frontend development. Experience working with source code repositories; familiarity with Visual Studio Online is an advantage. Proven T-SQL skills, including creating and maintaining stored procedures, tables, and views. Understanding of IT security standards and related design considerations. Understanding of source code review practices. Experience working in an ITIL-based environment. Willingness and ability to work the required shift schedule:  Morning shift: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM.   Night shift: 5:00 PM – 1:00 AM the following day.   Expected rotation: approximately two weeks on the night shift followed by two weeks on the morning shift each month. Willingness to participate in the mandatory on-call rotation:   Approximately one week of on-call standby every six weeks.   During the standby week, the engineer must carry the on-call phone and be available to respond to urgent customer calls and connect online when needed. Remaining awake throughout the standby period is not required. Why You'll Love Working Here: Work with enterprise IT solutions and a broad range of application support technologies. Collaborate with technical teams and international stakeholders across the UK and Vietnam. Gain practical experience in application maintenance, incident management, and technical troubleshooting. Develop your technical expertise across Java technologies, databases, web services, and enterprise systems. Contribute to improving service reliability, support processes, and client solutions. CONTACT US: Email: talent.acquisition@watasoftware.com

Investigation, performance, and quality Investigate complex defects, including issues reported from customer deployments. Risk — identify technical risks, gaps and dependencies during the sales cycle, and make sure they are reflected in the proposal. Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept Presentations — prepare and deliver solution presentations, demonstrations and proofs of concept. Demo environments — maintain demo environments, presentation materials and technical documentation. Proposals and Tenders Technical proposals — prepare technical proposals, solution descriptions, scopes of work and related documentation. Tenders — support RFP, RFI and tender responses, including technical compliance and clarifications. Coordination and Handover Internal coordination — coordinate with technical, product, implementation and delivery teams. Handover — support the proper handover of awarded projects to the implementation and project teams. Product feedback — pass recurring customer requirements and competitive gaps back to the product team. Market and Product Knowledge Keep up to date with market trends, competitor solutions and customer requirements. Maintain in-depth, hands-on knowledge of Mirnah’s products, their configuration options and their integration capabilities. Handle customer information, requirements and system details confidentially, in line with Mirnah policies. What you'll bring 1 to 5 years’ experience in software pre-sales, business analysis, solution consulting, implementation or a similar role. Arabic is required , together with English, spoken and written. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong presentation, communication and customer-facing skills. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work closely with sales, technical and delivery teams. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and presentation tools. Willing and able to travel within Saudi Arabia for customer workshops, demonstrations and meetings. Nice to have Experience with enterprise software, cloud solutions, APIs, databases, mobility and integrations. Good understanding of business processes in FMCG, distribution, supply chain, logistics or field sales. Familiarity with ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle Fusion or JD Edwards, and with how field and warehouse data flows into them. Experience with sales force automation, van sales, warehouse management or demand planning solutions. Exposure to rugged mobile devices and enterprise device management, such as Honeywell devices and SOTI. Experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Qlik. Experience preparing RFP, RFI and tender responses. How we work Consultative approach - asks the questions that uncover the real requirement before proposing an answer. Technical credibility - explains architecture and integration clearly and accurately to business and IT audiences alike. Clear communication - turns complex solutions into clear presentations and documents, in Arabic or English. Analytical thinking - breaks a customer’s operation down into processes, data and integration points. Realism - proposes only what can be delivered and raises risks openly. Collaboration - works as one team with sales, product and delivery colleagues. Organisation - runs several opportunities, demos and deadlines in parallel without losing detail. How success is measured The role is measured on the quality of the solutions it proposes and its contribution to winning business. These are the main measures; specific objectives are set and reviewed by the Sales Manager. Discovery - Captures customer business and technical requirements fully and accurately before a solution is proposed. Solution design - Proposes solutions that fit the requirement, are clearly scoped and can be delivered as sold. Demonstrations - Delivers demonstrations and proofs of concept built around the customer’s own scenarios. Proposals and tenders - Delivers technical proposals and RFP, RFI and tender responses on time and to a consistent standard. Risk - Identifies technical risks, gaps and dependencies early, before they become commitments. Sales contribution - Helps the sales team move opportunities forward and win them. Handover - Hands over awarded projects with complete scope, requirements and commitments, so implementation starts without rework. Demo readiness - Keeps demo environments and presentation materials current and ready for use at short notice. Working relationships Reports to the Sales Manager within the Sales / Commercial department. Works alongside Sales Account Managers as the technical lead on their opportunities, and coordinates with technical, product, implementation and delivery teams on solution design, scoping and handover. Externally, works with customers’ business, IT and operations teams, and with technology partners where a solution includes their products. Where and when The role is based in Mirnah’s offices in Saudi Arabia and combines office work - solution design, documentation and demo preparation — with workshops, presentations and demonstrations at customer premises. Travel within Saudi Arabia is required, sometimes at short notice, and the role may involve setting up and operating demonstration equipment such as rugged handheld devices.
